Theme

prayer book noun

also prayerbook, breviary

Renaissance

Liber precum pūblicārum (1560), the Latin Book of Common Prayer

liber precum

A plain description: precēs are prayers (Cic.). The Orthodox book of the Hours is the Horologion, the Western one the breviary.

Other words

  • breviārium, breviāriī n. — the breviary, the Western book of the Hours

    noun, second declension · also used · medieval · M-O s.v. breviary; Sen. Ep. 39.1, of a summary (Lewis & Short)

    Classically a summary or abridgment (Sen., Suet.).

See also book, the Lord’s Prayer, psalm.

SourcesLewis & Short: liber · Lewis & Short: prex · Lewis & Short: breviarius

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. breviary. Traupman and Levi–Bini have no word.

The 1560 Latin version of the Book of Common Prayer, Liber precum pūblicārum: its title as library catalogues give it (9 November 2026).
